pages.title: Surface Outposts
pages.text: Scattered across the Overworld surface lie fortified $(4)Manhattan Bunkers$(0). These surface structures house classified nuclear research and are tightly reinforced against blast damage.$(br2)Within each bunker, you will discover the solitary $(1)Manhattan Physicist$(0) tending to a dormant $(2)Fat Man$(0).

pages.title: Plutonium Cat Food
pages.text: The Physicist trades cans of $(2)Plutonium Cat Food$(0) for $(a)5 Emeralds$(0).$(br2)$(c)WARNING:$(0) Not for human consumption. Feeding this isotope to Fat Man triggers atomic mass accumulation.
